 October 24, 2026: Great weekend to enjoy the outdoors
 By: 
 Henry Rothenberg 
 Posted 
 Remaining Dry Through the Next Week 
 Forecast: 
 Tonight: Clear, Few Clouds Late |Low: 48| E-5
 Tomorrow: Mostly Sunny |High: 79| S-5
 In Depth: 
 Copy-&-Paste...that's the weather story as we head through the weekend. Daytime highs will climb into the 70s, and overnight lows will fall into the 40s and upper 30s.
 The Titans return home Sunday and the weather is looking great from tailgating throughout the game!
